5b1b1a6ef0b260c0.description: About the Role Harry Winston is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on delivering an exceptional luxury client experience, driving sales performance, and building long-term client relationships while upholding the brand’s heritage, values, and standards. The Sales Executive will be responsible for achieving individual sales targets and contributing to the boutique’s commercial success. Key Responsibilities Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to overall boutique sales objectives. Identify sales opportunities and convert boutique visitors into clients. Promote products, collections, and brand offerings in accordance with established standards. Demonstrate strong product knowledge, including technical features, craftsmanship, heritage, and storytelling. Maximize sales opportunities through cross-selling and up-selling techniques. Deliver a personalized luxury customer experience throughout the client journey. Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients. Conduct timely follow-ups on inquiries, quotations, reservations, and after-sales requests. Capture and maintain accurate client information within the CRM system. Support clienteling initiatives and VIP customer engagement activities. Ensure the boutique is maintained according to brand visual merchandising and operational standards. Support stock handling procedures and inventory accuracy. Continuously develop knowledge of products, collections, industry trends, and competitors. Represent the brand professionally at all times, maintaining a high standard of personal appearance. Collaborate effectively with boutique colleagues to achieve business objectives. Performance Indicators Performance will be measured against key indicators including: Individual Sales Achievement (% vs Target), Average Transaction Value (ATV), Units Per Transaction (UPT), and Conversion Rate. Number of New Clients Acquired, CRM Data Accuracy, Client Follow-Up Completion Rate, and Repeat Customer Rate. Customer Satisfaction Score, Mystery Shopper Score, and Service Quality Compliance. Inventory Accuracy and Compliance with Boutique Standards. Authority and Decision Making The Sales Executive manages customer interactions and sales opportunities within approved boutique procedures. This includes providing product recommendations and solutions to clients. Discount requests, complaints, or exceptional situations are to be escalated to management. The role does not include authority to approve discounts, special pricing, or policy exceptions. Key Challenges Challenges for this role include achieving ambitious sales targets in a competitive luxury market, building long-term relationships with high-net-worth clients, and maintaining luxury service standards during peak business periods. Balancing sales performance with exceptional customer experience and keeping client portfolios active and engaged are also critical aspects of the role. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position.

5beafaaf91e1949b.description: About the Role alfanar Group is seeking an Estimation Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing accurate cost estimates and quotations for products and customer inquiries. The specialist will evaluate technical requirements, material quantities, manufacturing needs, and pricing inputs to support competitive offers and informed commercial decisions. Key Responsibilities Review customer inquiries, specifications, drawings, and quantity schedules to establish quotation requirements. Identify missing information and clarify technical requirements with relevant teams. Prepare detailed quotations using approved estimation tools, verifying quantities, calculations, and pricing inputs. Estimate material, labor, machine time, and other manufacturing costs based on product requirements. Assess the cost impact of component selection, specialized materials, manufacturing methods, and customer specifications. Coordinate with engineering, production, procurement, and sales teams to validate technical requirements and cost inputs. Resolve estimation discrepancies and recommend suitable alternatives to improve cost-effectiveness. Check completed estimates for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with approved costing procedures. Maintain traceable records of rates, quantities, assumptions, calculations, and quotation revisions. Evaluate estimation methods and recommend improvements to accuracy, consistency, and efficiency. Provide practical guidance to less experienced engineers on estimation tools, calculations, and procedures. Role Accountabilities Obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Solve any related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in estimation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to alfanar Group's commercial operations.

5b478aecd8f59c5e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البيوت العصرية للديكور عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة السجلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف بنود من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، ويكون الدوام بنظام الدوام الكامل. سيعمل موظف الصندوق المحاسبي ضمن فريق مخصص لضمان سلاسة العمليات المالية وتقديم أفضل تجربة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الديكور والمساهمة في نجاحها.

5b65f2ef014e1de3.description: Role Summary The Senior Project Manager is responsible to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic software and IT services engagements for key customers in Saudi Arabia. The role combines delivery leadership, customer relationship management, commercial discipline, and governance. The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for managing complex, business-critical technology projects from initiation through successful delivery and closure, ensuring alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, quality standards, and organizational objectives. The position requires to provide senior-level leadership to multidisciplinary delivery teams, proactively manage project risks and dependencies, and maintain clear, decision-oriented communication with customer executives and internal leadership. Core Responsibilities Project Delivery Management · Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects and programs. · Develop and manage integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, quality, and acceptance criteria. · Monitor project performance and ensure delivery aligns with contractual commitments and business objectives. · Drive successful execution across all phases of the project lifecycle. Financial & Commercial Management · Manage project budgets, cost controls ( CPI monitoring [ME1] ), and financial performance. · Monitor resource utilization, project profitability, and delivery investments. · Track revenue milestones, customer acceptance, and contractual obligations. · Identify and manage commercial risks and contractual exposures. Change Management · Govern project change requests and scope modifications. · Ensure all changes are evaluated, estimated, approved, and contractually aligned before implementation. · Manage project baselines and change control documentation. · Minimize scope creep through disciplined governance. Resource & Capacity Management · Coordinate resource planning with PMO, engineering, operations, and supporting teams. · Manage project staffing requirements and allocation plans. · Identify resource constraints and implement mitigation strategies. · Optimize resource utilization across projects and workstreams. Stakeholder & Customer Management · Build and maintain strong customer relationships. · Lead customer governance meetings, steering committees, executive reviews, and status discussions. · Manage customer expectations and ensure timely decision-making and approvals. · Act as the primary escalation point for project-related matters. Leadership & Team Coordination · Coordinate activities across software engineering, QA, DevOps, architecture, infrastructure, security, business analysis, and external vendors. · Foster collaboration, accountability, and delivery excellence. · Support mentoring and guidance for Project Managers and delivery personnel. Delivery Methodologies & SDLC Oversight · Apply Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate. · Ensure adherence to Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes. · Oversee release planning, deployment coordination, testing, and production readiness. · Support continuous delivery and operational excellence practices. Vendor & Third-Party Management · Manage external vendors, partners, and subcontractors supporting project delivery. · Monitor vendor performance and contractual obligations. · Ensure third-party deliverables meet agreed quality and timelines. · Coordinate vendor dependencies and issue resolution. Project Recovery & Performance Improvement · Develop and execute recovery plans for challenged projects. · Address schedule slippages , quality concerns, budget overruns, and resource issues. · Implement corrective actions to restore project performance. · Continuously monitor and improve delivery effectiveness. Project Closure & Knowledge Management · Ensure successful project closure and operational handover. · Capture lessons learned and best practices. · Validate contractual completion and customer acceptance requirements. · Support realization of project objectives and business outcomes. PMO Continuous Improvement · Contribute to enhancement of PMO frameworks, tools, templates, metrics, and governance practices. · Promote project management best practices across the organization. · Support maturity improvement initiatives and delivery excellence programs. · Participate in internal PMO audits and process optimization activities. Pre-Sales & Transition Support · Support business development and pre-sales activities when required. · Contribute delivery estimates, assumptions, risks, resource plans, and implementation strategies. · Participate in solution reviews and transition planning. · Ensure delivery commitments are realistic and achievable. Qualification, Experience, Skills & Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A master’s degree in business, technology, or project management is an advantage. Professional Experience Minimum 10 years of total professional experience in software, technology, digital transformation, or IT services environments. Minimum 6 years of direct project management experience with accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and customer outcomes. Proven experience managing complex software development or systems integration projects through the complete lifecycle, from initiation and planning through deployment, acceptance, and closure. Demonstrated experience managing large enterprise or government customer accounts in Saudi Arabia. Strong experience within a software development, IT consulting, systems integration, or managed services organization. Experience leading cross-functional and geographically distributed delivery teams. Demonstrated exposure to project financials, contract management, change requests, resource planning, and commercial risk. Experience managing multiple workstreams, vendors, system dependencies, and senior stakeholders. Previous experience working within STC, government entities, or other major KSA enterprise environments is highly desirable. Technical & Delivery Knowledge Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and contemporary delivery models. Practical knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies. Good understanding of enterprise applications, digital platforms, APIs, integration architectures, cloud environments, and data migration. Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, quality assurance, and production deployment. Strong competence in project planning, effort estimation, resource forecasting, financial tracking, RAID management, change control, and executive reporting. Proficiency with common project and delivery management tools, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft 365. Certifications PMP certification is required. PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, CSM, PSM, or another recognized Agile certification is an advantage. ITIL or a relevant service management certification is an advantage for candidates with managed services experience. S kills & Competencies · Strong leadership with hands-on ownership of delivery outcomes. · Excellent stakeholder management and customer relationship skills. · Executive-level communication and presentation capabilities. · Professional fluency in English; Arabic communication capability is strongly preferred. · Strong commercial awareness and ability to identify contractual or financial exposure before it materializes. · Ability to challenge unrealistic expectations professionally and protect approved project scope. · Structured problem-solving, negotiation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills. · Ability to work effectively under pressure and lead recovery of complex or challenged projects. · Strong attention to delivery evidence, governance

5ba0f3cdb6e4fff3.description: About the Role Shanahan Engineering is seeking a Commissioning Leader to join their team in Jubail, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position with a duration of 12 months, renewable. The Commissioning Leader will act as Deputy Commissioning Manager, supporting the company's Project Management during the pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up phases. Key Responsibilities The primary role of the Commissioning Site Leader is to ensure that the CONTRACTOR's scope of services for pre-commissioning and commissioning preparation complies with contract and schedule obligations, and company specifications. This position involves ensuring the safe and smooth execution of all commissioning activities, adhering to the OPERCOM® methodology and proper use of ICAPS© software. Main accountabilities include: Supporting the review and approval of the CONTRACTOR's commissioning organization, deliverables, procedures, and planning activities. Developing pre-commissioning and commissioning activities with the proponent department. Participating in HSE activities. Managing systems and sub-systems definitions. Ensuring proper preparation and review of pre-commissioning and commissioning dossiers. Monitoring and reporting on CONTRACTOR/Subcontractor progress. Issuing periodic progress reports. Organizing and coordinating commissioning execution activities. Commissioning, testing, and safety procedures. Reliability strategies, including spare parts, redundancy, RBI programs, and turnaround planning. Contract Details The initial contract duration is 12 months, with the possibility of renewal. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

5bfa054291ed6aeb.description: About the Role MOBCO Group is seeking a Digital Marketing Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires extensive experience in digital marketing to develop, implement, and manage the company's overall digital marketing strategy. The primary goal is to strengthen brand visibility, enhance online presence, generate business leads, and support the company's business development objectives. Role Purpose The Digital Marketing Manager will be responsible for leading all digital marketing initiatives. This includes hands-on experience in online campaigns, social media management, SEO, paid advertising, content strategy, and digital analytics to drive measurable results and contribute to the company's growth. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives and brand positioning. Manage the company's digital presence across websites, social media platforms, search engines, and other online channels. Plan, execute, and optimize digital advertising campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta (Facebook and Instagram). Manage SEO and SEM strategies to improve website rankings, organic traffic, online visibility, and lead generation. Develop and implement social media marketing strategies, including content planning, publishing, audience engagement, and performance monitoring. Oversee website management, updates, landing pages, and digital content to ensure consistency with corporate branding. Plan and manage content marketing activities, including corporate presentations, marketing materials, videos, articles, newsletters, and promotional campaigns. Monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other analytics tools, providing actionable insights. Identify digital marketing opportunities, emerging trends, and new technologies to improve marketing effectiveness. Manage digital marketing budgets, advertising expenditure, and campaign ROI. Coordinate with internal departments, business development teams, and external agencies for effective marketing campaigns. Develop strategies to generate qualified business leads and improve customer engagement through digital channels. Monitor competitors' digital marketing activities and conduct market research for brand differentiation. Strong knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and digital performance tracking. Experience in website management, content marketing, lead generation, and conversion rate optimization. Ability to develop and manage digital marketing budgets and measure campaign ROI. Excellent understanding of branding, online reputation management, and digital communication. Strong analytical, strategic planning, leadership, and decision-making skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. 5bfc50abeb0f1e73.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث واحة المعرفة عن أخصائي أداء مؤسسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية، وتقييم النتائج، وتوثيقها، والمساهمة في تطوير إرشادات إدارة الأداء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مع التركيز على تحسين الأداء المؤسسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد مصادر المعلومات والبيانات الضرورية، وجمعها، وتنظيمها، وتحليلها لتحديد مؤشرات الأداء لكافة قطاعات الجهة المعنية. المشاركة في إعداد الإرشادات والتعليمات المتعلقة بأنشطة إدارة الأداء لجميع الوحدات التنظيمية. تقديم الدعم اللازم لكافة القطاعات لتمكينها من تقييم النتائج المتعلقة بمؤشرات الأداء وتوثيقها ضمن خطط الأداء. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة التطورات والمستجدات في مجال الأداء المؤسسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأداء المؤسسي، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها، وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة بالأداء المؤسسي. القدرة على تحديد مؤشرات الأداء وتقييم النتائج. مهارات جيدة في جمع البيانات وتحليلها وتنظيمها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد مؤشرات الأداء وتقييمها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات التواصل الفعال لدعم القطاعات المختلفة. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات في مجال الأداء المؤسسي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حائل، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز الأداء المؤسسي وتحقيق الأهداف الاستراتيجية للجهة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في واحة المعرفة.

5bd93ddd60e784da.description: About the Role The اللجنة الوطنية لرعاية السجناء والمفرج عنهم وأسرهم is seeking a Governance and Corporate Development Manager to join the General Administration for Planning and Institutional Excellence. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role is central to enhancing the institutional maturity, effectiveness, and readiness of the reform and rehabilitation ecosystem. Role Purpose and Context The Governance and Corporate Development Manager will be responsible for designing and updating governance frameworks, ensuring alignment of roles and responsibilities, and monitoring performance. The role drives continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and service quality, in adherence to regulatory mandates and stakeholder expectations within the reform and rehabilitation ecosystem. Key Responsibilities Develop, update, and maintain institutional governance frameworks and models for the reform and rehabilitation ecosystem, including defining roles, responsibilities, inter-entity relations, decision-making mechanisms, and joint accountability in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Design and implement methodologies and models to measure the institutional maturity and readiness of the ecosystem (including governance, institutional capabilities, integration, and joint workflow effectiveness), analyze assessment results, and set development and improvement priorities. Coordinate with relevant entities to update and develop reference frameworks, standards, and best practices that enhance governance quality, institutional integration, and ecosystem effectiveness, while supporting their adoption and activation according to approved frameworks. Develop indicators and methodologies to measure the adoption, activation, and compliance with approved frameworks, standards, agreements, and joint workflows, and monitor gaps and challenges to propose appropriate solutions. Study and develop mechanisms for institutional alignment, integration, and joint work among related entities (including joint work models, committees, operational mechanisms, escalation pathways, and follow-up) to enhance effectiveness and prevent duplication of roles and responsibilities. Develop frameworks to monitor and analyze institutional and strategic risks across the ecosystem—including risks of integration weaknesses, service continuity disruptions, capability gaps, and compliance issues—and propose proactive measures and treatments. Identify capability and enabler gaps affecting ecosystem effectiveness, propose initiatives to elevate maturity and readiness levels, and coordinate with stakeholders for implementation and progress tracking. Monitor the implementation of initiatives and joint improvement plans related to ecosystem governance and maturity, track progress, identify challenges, and escalate critical issues requiring decisions from competent authorities. Prepare regular reports and assessments on maturity levels, governance compliance, alignment, integration, and risk levels, and submit data-driven recommendations to decision-makers to prioritize development. Continuously update methodologies, manuals, models, and indicators related to ecosystem governance, maturity, and joint work, and promote their utilization through stakeholder collaboration. Leverage evaluation results, performance data, and changes in the regulatory and developmental context to identify opportunities for optimizing ecosystem governance, operational mechanisms, and standards, proposing necessary updates in coordination with relevant entities. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing governance frameworks. Proven ability to manage corporate development initiatives and drive institutional excellence. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the General Administration for Planning and Institutional Excellence at the اللجنة الوطنية لرعاية السجناء والمفرج عنهم وأسرهم.

5b19507c09eb6b60.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منطقة الذوق لتقديم المشروبات عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية إدارة الجوانب المالية للمؤسسة، مع التركيز على ضمان الاستقرار المالي والامتثال. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناتجة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتناسب الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الإدارة المالية والتدفقات النقدية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم توصيات مستنيرة. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات التحليلية والتنظيمية، بما في ذلك: مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم السيولة والمخاطر المالية. القدرة على التنبؤ بالتدفقات النقدية وتحديد المشكلات المحتملة. مهارات التفاوض والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم في تطوير السياسات المالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن شركة منطقة الذوق لتقديم المشروبات. ستعمل ضمن فريق مالي لدعم الأهداف التشغيلية والاستثمارية للمؤسسة.

5b4d72bbffcd9b2c.description: About the Role Al-Enjaz Company is seeking a Project Manager to oversee project planning and execution in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience, with a focus on road and infrastructure projects. Role Overview The Project Manager will be responsible for ensuring that all projects adhere to Performance-Based Contracts (PBC) standards and indicators. The role involves direct coordination with external stakeholders and managing on-site teams to achieve project objectives and maintain quality standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise project planning and execution, ensuring full compliance with Performance-Based Contracts (PBC) standards and indicators. Monitor and measure Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and the quality of field outputs to ensure payment eligibility and prevent operational deductions. Coordinate directly with consultants and representatives of the Ministry of Transport, fulfilling all accreditation requirements and submitting periodic technical and financial reports. Manage work teams and contractors, monitoring timelines and resource flow on site. Apply occupational safety standards and quality control according to approved requirements. Qualifications and Requirements Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering specialization. Mandatory Accreditation: Valid official accreditation as a Project Manager from the Ministry of Transport and Logistics Services. Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing road and infrastructure projects, with proven and direct practical experience in managing Performance-Based Contracts. Professional Membership: Valid and registered membership in the Saudi Council of Engineers. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires full-time commitment on-site. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

5b8f30b5f4791cff.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ضواحي الخير للنقل عن كهربائي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في السيارات، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تفسير المخططات الأولية لتركيب الأنظمة الكهربائية ومعدات السيارات. فحص الأجزاء الفردية والمجمعة جزئياً والكاملة لضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتحديد المشكلات والأعطال المحتملة. تنفيذ الخدمات والإصلاحات اللازمة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في السيارات، بما في ذلك أجهزة القياس، معدات الإضاءة، والمولدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات ككهربائي سيارات. معرفة قوية بالأنظمة الكهربائية للسيارات ومكوناتها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص وإصلاح الأعطال الكهربائية بدقة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المركبات، مع التركيز على جودة الأداء والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

5ba1f4aa91968768.description: About Al Woroud Real Estate Investment Al Woroud Real Estate Investment develops, owns, and manages a diversified portfolio across six core sectors. The company employs an institutional approach focused on asset quality, operational efficiency, and enduring value. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Procurement Engineer The Procurement Engineer will report to the Procurement Manager within the Development Management department. This is a client-side role responsible for managing tendering and award processes for contractors, consultants, and suppliers involved in project delivery. The focus is on ensuring efficient procurement rather than direct construction management. Key Responsibilities Prepare tender packages, including scope, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), technical requirements, and commercial terms, in collaboration with architecture and construction teams. Prequalify contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers, and maintain a comprehensive vendor database for all three cities. Manage the entire tendering process from issuance of documents and handling clarifications to performing technical and commercial evaluations and bid leveling. Benchmark costs against market rates and past projects to support the investment team with feasibility studies and budget preparation. Support negotiations and draft award recommendations and contract terms. Track awarded packages for variations, long-lead items, and supplier performance. Utilize AI and digital tools to enhance procurement speed and accuracy, covering bid comparison, document review, market research, and reporting. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Architectural Engineering, or Quantity Surveying. 6–14 years of procurement or tendering experience, with a minimum of 5 years in Saudi Arabia. Procurement experience with a major Saudi contractor (*, Nesma, El Seif, MOBCO, Al Bawani, Alghanim, Alrashid), combined with strong knowledge of the local supplier and subcontractor market. Accreditation from the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). Fluent English is required; Arabic is a plus. Transferable Iqama is preferred. Experience in using AI tools, such as agents and skills, to improve the speed and quality of procurement activities. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Procurement Engineer position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

5bd38969997c9050.description: About Elevate : Elevate is an award-winning global sports and entertainment agency founded in 2018 and the chosen growth partner for the world’s leading brands, properties, and experience driven businesses. Through one integrated model, Elevate serves as the trusted advisor for more than 1,000 clients, helping them solve complex challenges and drive business wins. What began in sports has evolved into a platform now serving clients across culture, attractions, culinary, and hotels. Today, Elevate brings operational expertise, data-driven intelligence, and world-class creativity together under one roof. Elevate’s more than 750 employees sit across 14 offices around the world, from North America to Europe to Asia, and speak and write in 17 different languages. For more information, visit us at www.oneelevate.com . The role: We are looking for a Director to lead sponsorship and partnerships sales for our rights holder clients in Saudi Arabia, across sport, culture and entertainment. The role sits within our MENA Partnership Sales unit, a team of 20+ people across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Jeddah, Riyadh and Bahrain. You will open and develop relationships with brands in the Kingdom, shape partnerships around their objectives and close agreements that our clients and their partners can build on over several years. Key responsibilities: Sell sponsorship and partnership rights on behalf of our rights holder clients in KSA, across sport, culture and entertainment. Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and first meeting to proposal, negotiation, contracting and handover to the servicing team. Build and maintain senior relationships with marketing and sponsorship decision-makers at Saudi brands, PIF portfolio companies, banks, telcos and giga-projects. Develop proposals that start from a brand’s objectives, with clear rationale, valuation and pricing. Structure deals thoughtfully, including value-in-kind (VIK), phased and activation-led partnerships where these serve both parties. Manage a disciplined pipeline in Salesforce and provide accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts. Work closely with our Partnership Sales Operations team to develop world class sales materials and data insights. Represent the business and our clients with professionalism in the Saudi market, and share market insight with the wider MENA team. What we are looking for: Experience: 8–10+ years in sponsorship sales, partnerships or brand partnerships, agency-side or rights holder side, in the Kingdom. A record of closing significant deals in sport, culture or entertainment, ideally multi-year or seven figure SAR partnerships. Experience owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting to negotiation, contracting and handover to servicing. Network and market standing: Established, current relationships with marketing and sponsorship decision makers at major Saudi brands, PIF portfolio companies, banks, telcos and giga projects. Credibility with government entities and rights holders Based in KSA, with a reputation for professionalism and trust. Commercial capability: Consultative selling built around brand objectives, rather than selling inventory. Sound judgement on valuation, pricing and deal structure, including VIK and activation-led partnerships. Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting; experience with Salesforce is preferred. Leadership and ways of working: Collaborative with our wider team, including Creative, Consulting and Partnership Sales Operations. Strong client management with rights holders (our clients) and with brands. Bilingual in Arabic and English, with polished written proposals in both. High integrity on compliance, conflicts of interest and confidentiality.

5b7901f8bac4389e.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems is the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, operating under Government-to-Government arrangements to provide equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation initiatives. The Role: Aircrew Training Device (ATD) Instructor Pilot (Advanced) This full-time position is for an Aircrew Training Device (ATD) Instructor Pilot (IP) (Advanced) based in Tabuk. The Hawk T-165 ATD Simulator Instructor Pilot is a key member of the King Fahad Air Base (KFAB) Operations and Aircrew Training (O&AT) operations delivery team. This role contributes significantly to the Entry into Service (EIS) and transition to the O&AT Hawk T-165 Service Delivery (SD) of the KFAB Hawk T-165 ATD. During sustained SD, the ATD Simulator IP will contribute to the coordination, update, and delivery of the KFAB Hawk T-165 ATD training service. Key Accountabilities Support the O&AT ATD Service Delivery. Operate within the ATD training Concept of Operations (CONOPS) to meet O&AT requirements for all initial, conversion, and continuation training syllabuses. Coordinate and conduct ATD scheduled events in accordance with RSAF and BAESSA training and governance policies. Coordinate instructional and support staff to adequately resource ATD scheduled events. Maintain ATD instructional standards and ensure ATD output meets or exceeds customer requirements. Support ATD management, instructional, and support staff to ensure the ATD training service utilises best practice and delivers an optimum solution for KFAB Hawk units. Coordinate other ATD Simulator Pilot currency, competency training, and evaluation. Training Delivery Responsibilities Deliver scheduled training to the required standard on the Hawk T-165 Full Mission Simulator (FMS). Deliver scheduled training to the required standard on the Hawk T-165 Integrated Procedures Training (IPT). Deliver scheduled training to the required standard on the Hawk T-165 Egress Training Device (ETD) and Ejection Seat Training Device (ESTD). Deliver scheduled ground training to the required standard in the Hawk T-165 Multimedia Computer Based Training (MCBT) classroom. Utilise the Flying Operations Training Management Information System (TMIS) and Learning Management System (LMS). Update courseware utilising the Learning Content Management System (LCMS) and in accordance with DSAT processes. Administer and grade trainee ground-based examinations. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Employee Benefits For expatriate employees, a competitive salary is offered along with rent-free accommodation and access to free recreation facilities within Company secured accommodation. A generous leave and travel allowance is also provided. Initial appointment to Saudi Arabia will be on single status, with the opportunity to apply for family to join at a later stage. A full health care scheme is provided within Saudi Arabia. Saudi National employees will receive a competitive salary and benefits package, including a generous leave and travel allowance, a full health care scheme, and access to subsidised recreational facilities.

5b3485a45bd202ef.description: About Alqotr Alqotr is seeking an Architectural Supervision Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for professionals with 5-10 years of experience in architectural supervision. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to supervise the execution of architectural works on site, ensuring strict compliance with approved drawings, detailed specifications, and quality standards. The Architectural Supervision Engineer will coordinate with various disciplines to ensure project delivery aligns with the approved design intent and required standards. Key Responsibilities Provide daily supervision of architectural works on site, including finishes, façades, ceilings, flooring, doors, glass, stone, aluminum, and woodworks. Monitor execution quality to ensure all works comply with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Review architectural details for accuracy and constructability. Monitor façade works and various architectural systems to ensure quality execution. Review and approve Shop Drawings to ensure alignment with the approved architectural design. Review and verify Detail Drawings for accuracy and execution feasibility. Review and approve Mockups prior to full-scale execution. Review and approve Material Submittals to ensure compliance with project specifications and design requirements. Coordinate with other disciplines (Civil, Electrical, and Mechanical) to resolve site conflicts and ensure smooth project execution. Supervise contractors and site technicians to ensure works are executed according to project requirements. Participate in site meetings and prepare technical meeting minutes. Prepare Snag Lists and follow up on closure prior to project handover. Prepare daily and weekly reports including progress updates, observations, and photographic documentation. Monitor the implementation of quality and safety standards across all architectural works. Ensure accurate implementation of the project’s visual identity and design intent. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in architectural supervision. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site supervision and coordination.

5b431624342ebdda.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a Lifting Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring safe and efficient lifting and handling operations, adhering to company standards and both local and international regulations. The Lifting Supervisor will oversee all crane lifts on site, manage daily documentation, and ensure compliance with site lift plans. Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and supervise all lifting activities within the project. Verify that all lifting gears are valid and in operational condition. Conduct pre-task briefings for all lifting team members, including crane operators, riggers, and signalmen, covering the Lifting Plan, risk control measures, and safe lifting procedures. Ensure all lift/riggers adhere to policies outlined in the Lifting Operators Manual. Prepare Lifting Plans and confirm the validity of Permit-To-Work (PTW) before commencing lifting operations. Ensure mobile crane operators and all related lifting equipment conduct pre-operation checks using company-prescribed checklists. Check load weights and radii to ensure proper understanding before lifting operations. Perform area inspections, set up barricade areas, and establish lifting zones to ensure safety prior to operations. Coordinate and supervise all lifting activities in accordance with the Lifting Plan. Implement suitable measures to rectify any reported unsafe conditions to ensure safe and continuous operation. Conduct on-job training for all lift standards and complete practical training reports. Perform minor maintenance tasks as required. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Ensure all rigging tackles used for lifting are in good condition and color-coded as per the monthly color code. Monitor equipment on site and coordinate with clients regarding any complaints, initiating immediate action. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of working experience, with at least 3 years in a relevant lifting supervision role. 2 years of GCC experience is preferred. College-level education in a related field (DAE). Possession of relevant technical certificates. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active on-site supervision of lifting operations and adherence to stringent safety protocols.

5b682f018ba4c340.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث وكالة عقال الراس عن مطور مواقع الكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تحليل احتياجات العملاء، وتطوير المواقع الإلكترونية، وضمان خلوها من المشكلات الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال تطوير المواقع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء التحاليل اللازمة لفهم احتياجات العميل ومتطلباته، وضمان توافق الموقع الإلكتروني معها. دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإلكترونية الحالية، وتقديم الملاحظات التصميمية والتقنية، والعمل على تنفيذها وتطويرها. إعداد خطط شاملة لتطوير وتحديث المواقع الإلكترونية من النواحي التصميمية والتقنية، بالاعتماد على أحدث الأساليب وأفضل التصاميم. اختبار المواقع الإلكترونية بعد التطوير للتأكد من خلوها من أي مشكلات فنية أو تقنية، والعمل على حلها فور اكتشافها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بتطوير المواقع الإلكترونية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير المواقع الإلكترونية. القدرة على تحليل احتياجات العملاء وتحويلها إلى متطلبات فنية وتصميمية. معرفة قوية بأحدث أساليب تطوير المواقع وأدوات التصميم. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المشكلات وتقديم الحلول. القدرة على إعداد خطط عمل مفصلة ومنظمة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة المواقع وخلوها من الأخطاء. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد وعرض التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق وكالة عقال الراس في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. تلتزم الوكالة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم التطوير المستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

5b992cc1675dce68.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مقياس واحد للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمهندسين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة، حيث يتطلب من 0 إلى 1 سنة من الخبرة. سيساهم المهندس المدني في دراسة وتصميم والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع الإنشائية، مع التركيز على الدقة الفنية ومطابقة المواصفات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي ونتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها وتدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على فهم وتحليل المخططات الهندسية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب وإجراءات العمل في المشاريع الإنشائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. مهارات التواصل الفعال. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشروع. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق هندسي متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في المشاريع الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. هذه فرصة للمهندسين المدنيين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة داعمة ومحفزة.

5bdbd1f95b5435bd.description: About the Role Jazera Arabia Contracting is seeking an Operations Coordinator to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting daily operational activities, coordinating internal processes, and ensuring effective communication across departments. The ideal candidate will possess strong administrative and coordination skills, along with a foundational understanding of recruitment processes to assist with hiring activities. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily operational activities to ensure smooth workflow across departments. Monitor work progress, schedules, and pending tasks for timely completion. Liaise with project teams, management, and external stakeholders. Prepare operational reports, maintain accurate records, and manage documentation. Follow up on internal requests, approvals, and administrative procedures. Support recruitment activities, including CV screening, interview scheduling, and candidate follow-ups. Assist in preparing job offers and tracking recruitment progress. Coordinate with the recruitment team and hiring managers to ensure efficient hiring processes. 5b866a30e5325bfd.description: About Noon Academy: Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity. Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here . Learn more about us [ here] The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What You Will Do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers. About you (To be successful in this role, you should have): Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment Nice to have: Game design or gaming industry experience. Large-scale B2C or e-commerce experience, where A/B tests and small-metric optimisation were the daily rhythm. Enough front-end to prototype in code with AI assistance. Why Noon? Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day. Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy. AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily. Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating. Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen. Benefits In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer: Performance-based bonus 21 days of annual leave Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent
